# ITD Simulator repository agent instructions

Before repository changes, fetch and read the persistent off-main scientific/ecosystem roadmap:

```bash
git fetch origin agent/ecosystem-roadmap && \
git show origin/agent/ecosystem-roadmap:.agent/ITD_SIMULATOR_ECOSYSTEM_ROADMAP.yaml
```

Treat root `AGENTS.md` as mandatory bootstrap policy. If the roadmap is unavailable, fail closed for major scientific-revision, confirmatory-study, cross-repository promotion, or merge decisions.

Preserve frozen ITD V29.18, the Missions 3–8 negative result, one-way isolation of new AI research, competent controls, leakage-safe evaluation, and the distinction between research evidence and downstream runtime policy.
